review.question: TP-1245 (The paused line on the ticket page) shows when a pause started. Should the paused line say since when the ticket is paused, or for how long?
review.recommendation_reason: A length reads the same at any hour and needs no date.
review.title: How should the times on the paused line read in dark mode?
review.why:
QA found the line hard to read when a pause is older than a day.

A clock time needs the date beside it after midnight; a length reads the same at any hour.
